title: Lightly Toasted Dutch Vegetable Hash
description: A cozy Dutch dish featuring vegetable stock and shio-koji-cure, with a nutty and crisp texture, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe is also anti-inflammatory-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the carrots, Brussels sprouts, and onion with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and turmeric until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, heat the vegetable stock in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the shio-koji to the vegetable stock and stir to combine.
After the vegetables have roasted for 25 minutes, remove them from the oven and stir to combine with the vegetable stock mixture.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are lightly toasted and crispy.
Remove the hash from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
